description: This Java class 'GroupsController' manages admin user group operations in a web application, including displaying groups, editing a specific group, and paginating group data, with security annotations and dependency injections.

classes.name: GroupsController
classes.description: Controller class for managing user groups in the admin interface.

methods.name: displayGroup
methods.description: Handles GET request to display a specific group for editing.

methods.name: displayGroups
methods.description: Handles GET request to display list of groups.

methods.name: pageGroups
methods.description: Handles POST request to return paginated group data in JSON format.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Sets the menu context for the admin interface.
